description: Context-safe usage audit query. Defaults to aggregated summary, supports precise search by execution_id/search_id/charge_outcome/credit range, and writes large exports to a local JSONL file instead of returning all rows.

end_date.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today UTC.

event_type.description: Filter by event type, for example tool_execute or search.

kind.description: Backend usage kind grouping when supported.

limit.description: Max rows for search mode. Default 10, hard max 50.

mode.description: summary returns aggregates, search returns capped rows, export_file writes JSONL locally. Default: summary.

start_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to yesterday UTC.

name: usage_history
